subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: Knowledge of own school: where to find different places in the school (toilet, office, play areas)

show.line: My school has classrooms, toilets, an office and a playground!

rounds.prompt: Where do we play at break?
Where do we wash our hands after the toilet?
What do we call the head of the school?
You feel sick at school. Who do you tell?

hints: Each place in school has a job.
The principal leads the whole school.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I need the toilet.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I go to the principal's office!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! I need the toilets.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: The toilets are where we go!

parent_line: Knows places in the school and the role of teacher and principal.
